Keeps all blocks from the same module, but still dedups by module ownership at the ConfigResource level, so a parent block targeting one instance wrongly drops child-module blocks targeting other instances or module instances; it fails 2 of 3 hidden tests.

Matches the reference by removing config-level dedup and moving parent-over-child precedence to instance level during expansion, and also guards the unclaimed-target path against duplicate nodes; the extras (sorted child traversal, slices.Concat aliasing fix, changelog) are justified, and its unit and plan tests are thorough.
